question_stem: Explain the photoelectric effect and calculate threshold wavelengths.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by the photoelectric effect.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Calculate the energy of a photon of wavelength $436\text{ nm}$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: The work function of caesium is $1.4\text{ eV}$. Calculate its threshold wavelength.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: The work function of tungsten is $4.5\text{ eV}$. Calculate its threshold wavelength.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: State and explain whether photoelectric emission occurs for caesium and for tungsten when illuminated with light of wavelength $436\text{ nm}$.
